bestBets.overview: Intriguing 1880m maiden overall, average tempo expected up front. If here, APPEARED goes on top. Dual accepted for Wednesday's Canterbury meeting too. He has caught my eye in his trials, with the latest over 1200m clearly the pick. He has been off the scene a long time but looks well placed here. POWERFUL PRAYER is racing on the 7-day back-up off an encouraging Gosford run. Straight to 1880m from a good draw reads well. TACITLY draws poorly overall, peak fitness now third up and rises back to his pet trip where his sole career win came. JOIKA is another who draws out and will likely get back. She keeps Bullock on board and has already ticked this track and trip box.

raceTips.comment: Joika has shown enough ability in recent outings and looks suited getting into a race where she can settle just behind the speed and be saved for one run at them. Tacitly has been racing consistently and should appreciate a genuine tempo, with the ability to finish off strongly if within striking distance turning for home. The Cristal has been competitive without having everything go her way and gets another chance to find the right race shape, with a soft run likely to bring her into contention. Powerful Prayer possesses enough early speed to settle handy and can give a good kick when asked for an effort in the straight. Joika gets the nod with an in-form jockey on board and should receive every chance from the expected map.

bestBets.overview: 900m Super Maiden, as you'd expect, plenty of speed present up front over the short-course trip. Wide-open event. ESNAAD goes on top but is very short. She's yet to settle in her trials, which has seen her be very weak late. She looks very well placed over 900m on debut but I dare say the final 100m will be dicey. LET THERE BE DRUMS is the danger, liked what she did in a recent trial over 800m at Hawkesbury. Second prep and should be running on. POINTY END has enough talent to be in the mix. Home track and gets the in-form Gibbons in the saddle. SIMPLE PLEASURES didn't handle her debut experience, solid enough trial back this prep and draws well.

raceTips.comment: Pure Ecstasy fought on well through the line over 1000m on debut last start and would have taken considerable improvement off that run, maps to enjoy a soft run stalking the speed and saved for one sprint at them late. Final Gift is now ready to peak this preparation and if able to reproduce the rating from two starts back will be fighting out the finish, has the early speed to make his own luck handy throughout. Expecting strong first up performances from Let There Be Drums & Simple Pleasures over he suitable 900m with in form jockeys on board both gallopers.

bestBets.overview: Second of the 900m races across the program. THE WARRIOR goes on top for the Paul Perry camp, back-to-back improving efforts this time in. Quite strange to see him go back to 900m here but we will trust Paul. COSMIC ORDER comes through a very strong-rating C1 last time out. She'll find this much easier and is suited around that 900-1000m trip. AETERNUM is the market mover, an in-form Schofield goes aboard from a perfect gate. Country form but I dare say that'll be enough to win this. THIRD BASE rounds out the numbers.

raceTips.comment: Aeternum has been building a solid profile and looks capable of settling closer to the leaders before producing a sustained finish, which should suit the way this race shapes. The Warrior has the race experience to handle pressure and should be able to roll forward without doing too much work, giving him every opportunity to fight out the finish. Third Base has shown a good turn of foot and will be dangerous if able to conserve enough energy early, with his best work expected late. Cosmic Order has ability but needs to put himself into the race at the right time, as giving the leaders too much start could make the task difficult. Aeternum remains the selection with an in-form jockey aboard and looks well placed to make his presence felt.

bestBets.overview: Smaller field here but still enough tempo expected up front to see all horses get their chance. GOLD GLOBE comes through a strong enough midweek maiden and looks very well placed here back in grade sharply. Slightly sticky map but we will bank on McEvoy getting it right. THE PROSPECT has been let up six weeks with a 1000m tick-over trial. He is looking for 1600m but his fitness may be a query late. HELICONIA is in a very similar boat, a gap between runs and a tick-over trial, but has dropped back in trip which is ideal. Outside of that, QUADRIA rounds out the numbers peaking fourth up.

raceTips.comment: Gold Globe has been holding his form well and looks suited by a race where he can find a comfortable position and build momentum before the home turn. Quadria is another with enough tactical speed to settle within striking distance and should appreciate being able to dictate her own terms early. My Cartouche has shown glimpses of good ability and can improve sharply with the right run, particularly if able to settle with cover and produce one sustained burst. Heliconia is capable of getting into the finish when she finds clear running at the right stage and should not be overlooked if the tempo increases. Gold Globe gets the preference after showing the right racing pattern and should have conditions to suit.

bestBets.overview: Good little race this. The Brad Widdup-trained AVON CALLING is knocking on the door for a win. She was back and wide at Kembla Grange last time out, an inferior setup, but kept closing to run a bold second. She moves to a similar track here but should find this race easier. Not sure what to make of PLUME, she tends to always put in some mixed trials and similar on race day with her efforts. Once again in the mix here fresh. PHOTOSHOP peaks now third up after bouncing back well in her second career start. ZOUSARI rounds out the numbers, looking to improve sharply here second up.

raceTips.comment: Very keen on the lightly raced Avon Calling now at peak fitness this preparation after hitting the line powerfully over 1150m last start maps to enjoy the run of the race stalking the speed and is well suited out to 1250m. The John Sargent trained Photoshop improved sharply last start when hitting the line powerfully late over 1300m, maps well and with general improvement between runs will figure in the finish. The consistent Plume is well placed resuming over the 1250m and if able to reproduce the rating from her fresh performance last preparation she will figure in the finish.

LEGO MASTER comes off a strong fresh win and has tactical speed, strips fitter and is the horse to beat now. WOODROW strips fitter and can land up on speed also. Not sure what to make of the latest trial of ANDRON, he's better than that and we should see it from a positive draw here.

raceTips.comment: The lightly raced and talented Asilah from the Chris Waller stable is perfectly placed resuming over the 1400m, if able to reproduce a rating close to her fresh performance last preparation she will be winning and progressing to much higher class races. Broadway Street has performed strongly first up over his short career, will settle off the speed and saved for one sprint at them late. Lego Master & Woodrow bring the required last start form into the race and with improvement between runs will both figure in the finish.

bestBets.overview: Very tricky race to assess this far out. ASILAH goes firmly on top if she's here and makes the field. She's a lovely progressive type who can rocket through the grades. DIVINE SECRETS goes on top if there is no ASILAH. Loved her two recent trials when closing off beautifully out wide under limited riding. She maps ideally, keeps Chad and is suited over 1250m. The consistent 7yo NOSEY PARKER goes in the mix, career-best last-start effort and should roll across from gate 11. EQUILIBRIST can find form here back in grade and with the strong booking of Nash Rawiller. CALL ME SASSY comes through a strong enough last-start race, sticking to these bigger tracks is a smart move. NAFANUA is next best for the Baker x Gibbons combination.

raceTips.comment: The classy Asilah is perfectly placed resuming over the 1250m, if bale to reproduce the rating from her fresh performance last preparation she will be winning and progressing to higher class races. Nosey Parker has been racing in good fashion and possesses the tactical speed to settle prominently without needing to overdo it early, which should leave plenty in reserve for the straight.

bestBets.overview: PRINCE OF SORTS goes on top here in the last. He comes through a strong last-start race behind SPONARS and DORADUS, gets in light with the 2kg claim and is ready to rise to 1600m with 20 days between efforts. TACT put in a prep-best run third up, strips even fitter now fourth up and should appreciate a slightly firmer deck here. UNCLE HARRY has found form in his past two starts, inside draw and has a nice record at this track and trip. THE STARS ALIGN is a 1600m specialist, forgive last start when thrown in the deep end, back in grade here is key.

raceTips.comment: Tact has shown enough speed and determination to make his presence felt, with the ability to settle handy and put himself into the race before the final stages. Rush Attack can be a threat with a smoother passage and should be hitting the line strongly if able to conserve his energy early. Prince Of Sorts has been competitive around this level and gets his opportunity to show that he can finish closer with the right tempo, particularly if the leaders overdo it. Uncle Harry has the ability to race prominently and can give a bold sight for a long way if allowed to find his rhythm.
